items.name: MIMESIS
items.sub: ReLU Games, Inc. · Action, Adventure, Casual
items.desc: A 4-player online co-op survival horror game. Avoid the contaminated rain, gather scrap and get back to the tram. Monsters that copy your friends' voices and behavior, and many other threats, stand in your way. Gear up and stick together to survive.

items.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator
items.desc: IRON NEST is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

items.name: Alchemy Factory
items.desc: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

items.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
items.sub: Lavaflame2 · Idler, Pixel Graphics, Free to Play
items.desc: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

items.name: No More Room in Hell 2
items.sub: Torn Banner Studios · Early Access, Zombies, Multiplayer
items.desc: No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense 8 player zombie shooter. Overcome the endless undead. Avoid infection. Survive hell together.

items.name: Voidtrain
items.sub: HypeTrain Digital · Open World Survival Craft, Co-op, Survival
items.desc: Become a crew member of an Interdimensional Express Train! Discover a new world full of mysterious creatures, enemies and places. Upgrade and customize your train, gather new materials and build better weapons. Play solo or online сo-op with up to 4 people.

items.name: Tavern Keeper 🍻
items.desc: From the creators of Game Dev Tycoon comes Tavern Keeper 🍻, a cosy-chaotic management sim, featuring a powerful decoration sandbox and a magical storybook RPG!

items.name: CUSTOM PENNANT BASEBALL
items.desc: Draft prospects, develop your players and build a championship club. Set lineups, negotiate contracts and manage your budget in this baseball management sim. Discover hidden prospects, invest in your town and customize your league. Watch games without direct player control.

items.name: Date Everything!
items.desc: Date Everything! is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

items.name: Renz Soccer Sim
items.desc: Build your squad, develop players, manage your club, and watch every match unfold in this 2D soccer management simulator. Chase trophies and build a dynasty.

items.name: Bunny Bun
items.desc: You are the experimenter Bunny Bun. To develop the “Wisdom Potion,” you have brought your talents to this laboratory. You must process raw materials and synthesize them to create potions with specific effects. To test a potion, you can take a sip and go crazy. The world needs you...

items.name: Starfall Hill
items.desc: Stars really fall from the sky over a quiet hilltop village. Gather them, light the lamps, and meet the villagers—until a black warship crosses the moon. Take up an old rifle and exploding stars to defend the hill in this story-driven first-person adventure.

items.name: Ashen Knight
items.desc: A dark fantasy survivor roguelike with automatic combat, where every run starts from nothing. Unlock unique heroes, experiment with powerful skill builds, and survive relentless enemy waves.

items.name: 7 Millimeters
items.sub: DNA ARMY GAMING · Action, Casual, Simulation
items.desc: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?
